invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieMergeHandle created by HoodieMergeHandleFactory.create, so result is never null.
instantTime is required for record updates and is used unconditionally in the method.
partitionPath is passed unconditionally and used in handle creation, so it should be non-null.
fileId is required for locating the file to update and is directly passed into the handle.
keyToNewRecords is passed to the handle creation method and is expected to not be null.
